name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
title: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd - 540699 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue flat on smartphone demand and memory-cost headwinds; management guides FY27 non-Vivo volumes flat with 12-15% price-led mobile revenue growth, PLI roll-off trims margins ~50-70bps, and display/camera backward integration is the margin lever for FY27-28.

utilisation.quote: Construction of our 1 million square feet facility in Noida with higher capacities for our anchor customers is nearing completion, and we expect the operation to commence by Q2 this fiscal.

capex.quote: As far as the absolute number is concerned, it will be in the similar range.

triggers.label: Mobile selling prices +12% to 15%
triggers.quote: expect a high -double-digit growth quarter-on-quarter in the smartphones volume along with growth in selling prices by 12% to 15%

triggers.label: Mobile volumes ordering improving
triggers.quote: we are beginning to see an improvement in customer ordering pattern

triggers.label: FY27 non-Vivo revenue target INR56,000 cr
triggers.quote: Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat.

triggers.label: Margin pressure from PLI roll-off
triggers.quote: Obviously, there is a margin pressure because of the PLI going away.

triggers.label: IT hardware revenue 3x to INR4,000 cr+
triggers.quote: we expect 3x growth in the revenues in the current fiscal against last year

guidance.quote: we feel that the overall volumes without Vivo is going to be almost similar
Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers
We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27.
The next year target is almost INR1,700 crores.
We are targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores in that business.

guidance.value: margin under pressure this year; ~40-50bps expansion once components deployed
guidance.quote: there will be a margin expansion from last year's number by almost 40 bps, 50 bps.
without the Vivo also, the company will keep growing at almost 15% to 17%
